import { forwardRef, Global, Module } from '@nestjs/common';
import { APP_GUARD } from '@nestjs/core';

declare const chooseGuardAtRuntime: boolean;

export class AuthGuard {}
export class AuditGuard {}
export class NotesController {}
export class NotesService {}

// CASE:module-use-class-global-guard
@Module({
  providers: [
    AuthGuard,
    {
      provide: APP_GUARD,
      useClass: AuthGuard,
    },
  ],
  exports: [AuthGuard],
})
export class AuthModule {}

const AUDIT_GUARD_PROVIDER = {
  provide: APP_GUARD,
  useExisting: AuditGuard,
};

// CASE:module-use-existing-global-guard
@Global()
@Module({
  providers: [AuditGuard, AUDIT_GUARD_PROVIDER],
  exports: [AuditGuard],
})
export class AuditModule {}

// CASE:module-forward-ref
@Module({
  imports: [forwardRef(() => AppModule)],
  providers: [NotesService],
  controllers: [NotesController],
  exports: [NotesService],
})
export class NotesModule {}

const STATIC_IMPORTS = [AuthModule, AuditModule] as const;
const STATIC_PROVIDERS = [NotesService] as const;

// CASE:module-static-metadata
@Module({
  imports: [...STATIC_IMPORTS, NotesModule],
  providers: [...STATIC_PROVIDERS],
  controllers: [NotesController],
})
export class AppModule {}

// CASE:module-lookalike-token
const LOCAL_APP_GUARD = 'APP_GUARD';
@Module({
  providers: [{ provide: LOCAL_APP_GUARD, useClass: AuditGuard }],
})
export class LookalikeTokenModule {}

// CASE:module-ambiguous-guard-class
const SelectedGuard = chooseGuardAtRuntime ? AuthGuard : AuditGuard;
@Module({
  providers: [{ provide: APP_GUARD, useClass: SelectedGuard }],
})
export class AmbiguousGuardModule {}

function buildProviders(): unknown[] {
  return [];
}

// CASE:module-dynamic-metadata
@Module({
  providers: [
    ...buildProviders(),
    {
      provide: APP_GUARD,
      useFactory: () => new AuthGuard(),
    },
  ],
})
export class DynamicProviderModule {
  static forRoot(): unknown {
    return DynamicProviderModule;
  }
}

// CASE:module-dynamic-import
@Module({
  imports: [DynamicProviderModule.forRoot()],
})
export class DynamicImportConsumerModule {}
